title: fix(plugin-audit): a comment write leaves a ledger row and an activity row, stamped when the author was impersonated
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi9Hju7DThD7eoLKoJU9hnHj)_

Fixes #30979

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：评论（`sys_comment`）不再在审计镜像的跳过名单里。新建、编辑、删除评论现在和其他记录一样，各写一行审计（`sys_audit_log`）和一行动态（`sys_activity`）；管理员模拟员工时写的评论，两行都带上「谁代谁」的标记。
- **为什么改**：按你在 #30213 选的 A（「A 评论也记审计和动态」）。之前模拟时写的评论和员工本人写的完全分不出来。
- **风险与回滚**：每条评论多两行数据；这两行只给能读这条评论（即能读评论所在记录）的人看，复用评论自己的读权限，没有新判断。记录详情页的动态流不会重复显示（它只读记录本身的动态）。回滚即撤销本 PR，已写下的行保留。
- **先看**：`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts`（跳过名单那一处）；`src/activity-read-visibility.integration.test.ts` 末尾新增的读可见性用例。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit exec vitest run src/activity-actor-name.test.ts src/activity-read-visibility.integration.test.ts`，预期全部通过（34 条）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts`: `'sys_comment'` leaves `SKIP_OBJECTS`, so `AUDIT_EXCLUDED_OBJECTS` (derived from it) no longer lists it. A comment insert, update and delete now pass through `writeAudit` like any other object: one ledger row, one activity row, and PR #30800's impersonation stamp (`metadata.impersonated_by` on both, `impersonated_by_name` on the activity row) when the write came from an impersonation session. A comment above the list says why comments are not on it. Two stale code comments that said comments are skipped are corrected. No new column, no migration (option B was not chosen).
- Readers of `AUDIT_EXCLUDED_OBJECTS`, checked:
  - the hook registrations' `excludeObjects` (the same list): comment writes now open the global after-phase hooks;
  - `parent-record-read-gate.ts` `enumerateParentObjects`: the activity and ledger gates now enumerate `sys_comment` as a parent. `sys_comment` carries an object-scoped read middleware (`installCommentReadVisibility`), so the planner routes it to the bounded probe (ADR-0139 D5.2), which reads `sys_comment` as the caller under that same comment gate. That is the read visibility the card asks for, with no second judgment;
  - `comment-access-hooks.ts` `commentThreadGate().namedParents`: it shrinks by `sys_comment`, which the comment gate already skips as its own gated object (`name === gate.object` is tested first), so the comment gate's parent set is unchanged.
- Recursion: the "(1) recursion" group is about the audit and activity tables themselves, which stay listed. The writer writes only `sys_audit_log` and `sys_activity`; nothing it writes is a comment.
- `.changeset/30979-comment-writes-audited.md`: patch for `@objectstack/plugin-audit`.

## Step 1 measurement: no timeline duplication (read at origin/main 5f0037449)

- The record page's 动态 stream reads `sys_activity` filtered to the RECORD's own pair: ui `RecordDetailView` `activityWindowQuery` (`object_name: objectName, record_id: recordId`), and the server record-page payload and timeline count (`packages/rest/src/record-page-routes.ts`, `where: { object_name: object, record_id: id }` and `ofRecord`).
- The mirror writes a comment's activity row with `object_name: 'sys_comment'` and `record_id` the comment's id (`activityRow.object_name = ctx.object`), so it never matches the parent record's filter. No writer emits the `commented` activity type.
- So a comment shows once on its record (from `sys_comment`), as before. Its new activity row appears only in the object-agnostic feeds (home recent activity, the bell's Activity tab, the `sys_activity` list) as a created/updated/deleted Comment entry, where no comment entry existed. No UI change is needed.

## Tests

- `activity-actor-name.test.ts`, new describe "a comment written from an impersonation session is recorded like any other write": an impersonated comment insert writes one ledger row and one activity row, both stamped with the administrator; an impersonated edit and delete are stamped too; CONTROL: the user's own comment writes both rows, unstamped.
- `activity-read-visibility.integration.test.ts`, new describe "a comment's ledger and activity rows are served only to a reader of the comment" (real kernel, real `AuditPlugin`, SQLite): each member is served the activity and ledger rows of the comment on its own record and neither row of the other member's comment (list, id-scoped find, count); controls: both comments' rows exist (system read), the comment gate answers each member its own comment, the admin is served both.
- `audit-hook-object-scope.test.ts`: the two assertions that pinned `sys_comment` as excluded now pin the reverse (not in `excludeObjects`; the comment insert has a `create` ledger row).

## Acceptance notes

- A holder of the ledger's audit capability (`view_all_audit_log`) keeps reading every ledger row of the organization, comment rows included, as for every other object (the gate's declared exemption). The activity stream has no exemption.
- Comments written before this change have no rows; nothing is backfilled.
- `os migrate comment-parent-pair --apply` boots `AuditPlugin` and updates unstamped comments through the engine as the system, so each stamped comment now also leaves one system-actor `update` ledger row and activity row. Raised for the seat in the report; not changed here (outside this card's file surface and a separate decision).
- `identity-objects-feeds-off.test.ts` boots a `single` posture without a Default Organization, so its comment writes now print the writer's own one-time `Audit write FAILED ... ERR_SYSTEM_WRITE_ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED` error line. That suite still passes; the line is the writer correctly reporting its harness.

## Verification

All readings at head `8bc2feca4` (merge base `5f0037449` = current `origin/main`; no main commits since).

- `bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh -c "pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit test"` :: exit 0 — Test Files 76 passed (76), Tests 1201 passed (1201).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit typecheck` :: exit 0 (tsc src + scripts + test-typecheck).
- `eslint --no-inline-config` over the four touched source and test files :: exit 0 (the package declares no lint script; the repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's).
- Ablation 1, writer (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit 1, restored blob == HEAD): `'sys_comment'` put back on `SKIP_OBJECTS` → `activity-actor-name.test.ts` + `activity-read-visibility.integration.test.ts`: 6 failed / 28 passed (all three impersonation pins, the CONTROL pin, the rows-exist control, the visibility pin and the admin control). Restored: green.
- Ablation 2, read visibility: the comment read gate's registration (`engine.registerMiddleware(gate, { object: COMMENT_OBJECT })` in `comment-access-hooks.ts`) deleted → 2 failed / 14 passed: the comment-gate control and "a reader without read access to the comment's record is served neither of its rows" (`expected [ two comment ids ] to deeply equal [ one ]`: the other member's comment rows were served). Restored: green. So the rows' visibility is the comment gate's own answer, read through the probe.
